title: Candidate Workspace (/dashboard) 10/10 Transformation — Workspace-First Layout, Collapsible Copilot, Grid/List Views & Golden-Ratio Cards
spec: MANDATE: Execute end-to-end 10/10 transformation of the Candidate Dashboard (/dashboard, DashboardHomepage.jsx, CubaCandidateShell.jsx, CandidateExecutiveRail.jsx, CopilotHeroHud.jsx): 1) FLEXIBLE WORKSPACE-FIRST LAYOUT: Replace rigid static 7fr/3fr split with an expansive workspace-first layout featuring a collapsible/expandable AI Career Copilot rail/drawer. When collapsed, the resume workspace expands to full width; when docked, it smoothly shares the viewport. 2) CONDENSED COMMAND HUD (~75-90px): Unify greeting, friendly mascot, live status pill, metric capsules (Resumes, ATS, Applications, Coach), and the SINGLE authoritative [+ Create Resume] CTA into one sleek horizontal HUD, eradicating the duplicate button from the toolbar and freeing vertical space. 3) WORKSPACE TOOLBAR WITH VIEW TOGGLE & SORT: Clean segmented category pills ([scrollbar-width:none]), responsive search input (Ctrl+K), Sort dropdown (Last Updated, ATS Score, Title), and View Toggle (Grid vs. Compact List). 4) GOLDEN-RATIO RESUME CARDS: Readable title + relative timestamp ('Updated 2h ago') + color-coded ATS badge + crisp proportional thumbnail + 1-click Primary [Edit Resume] button + secondary icon actions [PDF], [Word] and [•••] overflow menu (Share, Duplicate, Rename, Delete). List View option for dense document management. 5) CONTEXT-AWARE AI COPILOT: Bind AI Briefing and Quick-Pitch to active resume data; display actionable keyword gap pills ([+ Docker], [+ CI/CD]) with 1-click tailoring flow. 6) VERIFICATION: Author tests/dir090-candidate-dashboard-mastery.test.mjs (AC1-AC7), ensure zero whole-window scroll, sub-4s build, 0 lint errors, frozen 55 CV templates diff 0.

That is the 7fr/3fr geometry to be replaced by a collapsible rail. THE DUPLICATE CTA IS CONFIRMED TWICE OVER, WHICH IS ONE MORE THAN THE BRIEF SAYS: DashboardHomepage.jsx:1004 renders the hero CTA (HomepageHero.createResume) and DashboardHomepage.jsx:1221 renders a second cuba-btn-primary 'Create Resume' in the toolbar, and BOTH run the same onClick (clear currentResumeId, then navigate to /build-resume/heading?new=1). So there are two duplicate sources, not one, and removing the toolbar copy is a behaviour-neutral deletion because the hero CTA already performs the identical action. THREE FEATURES IN THE BRIEF DO NOT EXIST YET AND ARE GENUINELY NEW WORK: my sweep for viewMode, gridView, listView, sortBy and metaKey found NO view toggle, NO sort control and NO Ctrl+K search binding anywhere in DashboardHomepage.jsx, so S3 and the List View half of S4 are from scratch rather than a refinement. Likewise relative timestamps exist only for cover letters (line 1347) and NOT for resume cards, so the 'Updated 2h ago' treatment is new. In each case I will update the assertion to the new geometry while preserving its INTENT - that the workspace and the rail share the viewport in a defined ratio and that the HUD is a compact glass bar - exactly as I did for build-resume-completion-state in DIR-088 and dashboard-settings-ux-10-10 in DIR-089. PLAN. S1 the collapsible workspace-first layout with a docked/collapsed rail state, persisted so the choice survives navigation, and the workspace expanding to full width when collapsed. S2 the condensed 75-90px command HUD unifying greeting, mascot, status pill, the four metric capsules and the SINGLE authoritative Create Resume CTA, deleting the toolbar duplicate at 1221. S3 the workspace toolbar: segmented category pills using the plugin-free [scrollbar-width:none] [&::-webkit-scrollbar]:hidden form the repo now standardises on, a Ctrl+K search binding, a Sort dropdown (Last Updated, ATS Score, Title) and a Grid/List view toggle. S4 golden-ratio resume cards with a real relative timestamp, a colour-coded ATS badge derived from the existing ATS engine rather than an invented band, the primary Edit Resume action, the [PDF] [Word] [overflow] actions and a dense List View. S5 context-aware copilot binding the briefing and Quick-Pitch to the ACTIVE resume with keyword-gap pills that feed a one-click tailoring flow, using the real ATS keyword extraction. S6 tests/dir090-candidate-dashboard-mastery.test.mjs with AC1-AC7 plus the full gate suite. INVARIANTS: frozen 55 CV template modules diff 0, build under 4s, 0 lint errors, XAMPP-only servers, no auth/API/DB/RBAC change, and every existing pin preserved or explicitly superseded with its intent intact.
